script_src: JS sources (e.g. Google Maps API: https://maps.googleapis.com https://maps.gstatic.com)
style_src: stylesheet sources (Mapbox GL CSS, custom CDN themes)
img_src: image sources, including map tiles (OSM: https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org)
connect_src: XHR / fetch / WebSocket destinations (Mapbox tile API: https://api.mapbox.com; a WebSocket feed: wss://ws-feed.exchange.coinbase.com)
frame_src: iframe sources (Google Maps embed: https://www.google.com, Stripe checkout: https://js.stripe.com)
